phase: Phase 29: RF & Media Hardening (Forward Error Correction & Packet Loss Concealment)

stories.title: Multiplatform Block Erasure FEC Encoder & Interleaved Block Decoder
stories.description: Implement MeshPacketFecEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/ providing pure Kotlin block erasure forward error correction (configurable (N, K) parity framing) with zero Java dependencies (Rule 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Generates parity FEC packets for block of K voice packets with zero Java or C dependencies (Rule 3)
Reconstructs any single or multi-packet erasure within block when received count >= K
Supports dynamic FEC ratios (DISABLED, RATIO_4_1, RATIO_3_1, RATIO_2_1)

stories.title: Predictive Packet Loss Concealment (PLC) & Waveform Interpolator
stories.description: Implement AudioLossConcealment.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/ to synthetically reconstruct lost PCM audio frames when FEC erasure bounds are exceeded, using pitch-synchronous waveform replication and progressive attenuation decay.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthesizes missing PCM audio frames smoothly from preceding frame history
Applies 2.5 dB attenuation decay per consecutive lost frame up to 3 frames, then smoothly mutes to prevent robotic/metallic artifacts
Smooth cross-fading when real voice frame reception resumes

stories.title: Closed-Loop FEC Redundancy Governor & Cockpit Telemetry Wiring
stories.description: Integrate MeshPacketFecEngine and AudioLossConcealment into AudioPipelineSession.kt, AudioEngine.kt, IntercomHardwareBridge.kt, and IntercomBridge.kt (iOS Swift). Bind FEC ratio dynamically to composite Q_link link health. Expose live FEC recovery and PLC concealment telemetry in TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt.
acceptanceCriteria: Audio pipeline automatically encodes and appends FEC parity packets based on link health governor
Hardware bridges and iOS IntercomBridge stream live FEC recovered and PLC synthesized frame counts
TactileDiagnosticsSheet displays real-time FEC mode, recovery stats, and PLC activations
Adheres strictly to Rule 1 (100% Native SwiftUI on iOS) and Rule 2 (KMP shared logic)

stories.title: Multi-Node 25% Burst Loss Simulation Test & Multiplatform Certification
stories.description: Implement FecLossConcealmentSimulationTest.kt in commonTest simulating 25% random and burst dropouts across an 8-node convoy, certifying audio delivery continuity, and execute full multiplatform verification gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation test verifies complete voice frame reconstruction or concealment under 25% packet drop
100% test pass across all multiplatform test tasks (Rule 6)
Clean Android debug assemble and iOS simulator compilation (Rule 6)
